comment: Reviewed mapping from each qurl-connector-owned scenario in pre_retirement_scenarios.json to the exact qurl-connector strict-proof inventory rows whose attested pass discharges it. This file records a review decision, not a proof: an entry only states which Connector rows must be attested as passing before the qurl-go row can be asserted. It never marks anything passed, and it never relaxes a status. Every referenced name must exist in connector_strict_scenario_names.json, and every entry's test_name and evidence_kinds must match pre_retirement_scenarios.json and typed_evidence_contract.json exactly.

connector.dns_key_destination_source_obs.rationale: DNS and destination observations come from the four DNS rows, server-key and source observations from the key/source rejection rows, and the API-route-count observation from the lifecycle HTTP and relay route absence row.

connector.exact_artifact_manifest.rationale: The three Connector rows carrying build_provenance evidence are exactly the rows that bind repository commits and deployed image digests into the canonical phase manifest.

connector.frp_authenticated_login_before.rationale: Native KNK admission is proven by the assigned-cell KNK/COK row; the ordered authenticated FRP login before proxy registration is proven by the FRP admission row.

connector.hardened_linux_container.rationale: The hardened Linux image round trip proves the container itself; the dedicated Linux NET_ADMIN/KMS runner row proves it ran on the dedicated proof host rather than a GitHub-hosted runner.

connector.provision_journal_crash_consis.rationale: Exact one-to-one correspondence with the Connector provision journal crash-consistency row.

connector.real_backend_traffic.rationale: Both Connector round-trip rows require a real backend response through the admitted FRP path, on the host binary and in the hardened container.

connector.remove_journal_crash_consisten.rationale: Exact one-to-one correspondence with the Connector remove journal crash-consistency row.

connector.resource_id_distinct_from_knoc.rationale: Exact one-to-one correspondence with the Connector public-identity versus placement-identity row.

connector.sealed_restart_without_setup_m.rationale: A credentialless warm restart is only meaningful once the sealed-provider cold start proved the state was sealed, so both sealed-state rows are required.

connector.zero_http_network_capture.rationale: The packet capture row proves all native lifecycle traffic was UDP/NHP; the route-counter row proves no bootstrap, registration, completion, OTP/REG relay, refresh, or recovery HTTP path was used.
